name: merkle_odd_leaves_and_sorting
description: Validates that odd numbers of leaves are deterministically paired with a fixed empty-leaf constant (Option B) and evidence items are sorted lexicographically by unsigned big-endian bytes of (evidence_id, commitment)
oddLeafRule: Option B: Pair unpaired final leaf with EMPTY_LEAF_CONSTANT: H(last || EMPTY_LEAF_CONSTANT)
